verdict.rationale: Datalab is an API service, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for it. The evidence only mentions using an API key, account two-factor authentication and enterprise SSO. Nothing documents per-key scopes, permission restrictions, or issuing separate limited keys for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
